{
  "markdown": "- Patients with known hypersensitivity to Drug X, nivolumab, or any of their excipients.
- Prior treatment with Drug X or any agent targeting the same pathway as Drug X.
- Prior treatment with any anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 agent within 4 weeks prior to first dose of study treatment, except for the anti-PD-1 therapy that the patient progressed on (must have completed at least 4 weeks since last dose).
- Active central nervous system (CNS) metastases, as indicated by clinical symptoms, cerebral edema, or progressive growth. Patients with treated, stable CNS metastases (e.g., surgery or radiotherapy) are eligible if neurologically stable for at least 4 weeks and off corticosteroids for at least 2 weeks prior to first dose.
- Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive treatment within the past 2 years, except for vitiligo, resolved childhood asthma/atopy, or endocrinopathies managed with replacement hormones.
- History of interstitial lung disease, non-infectious pneumonitis, or uncontrolled pulmonary fibrosis.
- History of severe immune-related adverse events (irAEs) from prior immunotherapy requiring permanent discontinuation of that agent.
- Active infection requiring systemic therapy, including tuberculosis, HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C.
- History of allogeneic organ or hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
- Inadequate organ function at screening, defined as:
  - Hematologic: absolute neutrophil count < 1.5 × 10^9/L, platelet count < 100 × 10^9/L, hemoglobin < 9 g/dL.
  - Hepatic: total bilirubin > 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN) (except for Gilbert's syndrome), AST/ALT > 2.5 × ULN (or > 5 × ULN if liver metastases present).
  - Renal: serum creatinine > 1.5 × ULN or creatinine clearance < 40 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault).
- Significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months prior to first dose, including myocardial infarction, unstable angina, congestive heart failure (NYHA class III or IV), or uncontrolled arrhythmia.
- QTc interval > 480 ms on screening ECG (using Fridericia's correction) [TBD: if Drug X has known QT effects, consider stricter threshold].
- Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing potential not willing to use highly effective contraception during treatment and for at least 5 months after last dose of nivolumab (or longer per local label).
- Men with a partner of childbearing potential not willing to use adequate contraception during treatment and for at least 7 months after last dose of nivolumab.
- Any other malignancy within the past 2 years, except for adequately treated basal or squamous cell skin cancer, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or other in situ carcinoma.
- Known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial.
- Any condition that, in the investigator's judgment, would make the patient unsuitable for study participation or would jeopardize patient safety or study endpoints [TBD: specify if medical monitor review is needed].
- Receipt of live vaccines within 30 days prior to first dose of study treatment.
- Participation in another interventional clinical trial within 4 weeks prior to first dose, except for observational or follow-up studies.
- Inability to comply with the protocol, including required follow-up visits and procedures.
"
